title: Caption-led phone and assistant chat tour
summary: Short centred captions on black alternate with product moments: a 3D phone spins in, a tilted sign-up screen glides, an assistant chat types and streams, a payment flow confirms. A violet horizon arc sweeps and brightens toward the logo.
use_when: A consumer or fintech mobile app with two or three screens and an in-app assistant
Silent autoplay where small captions announce each feature before it is shown
Showing an AI answer that turns into one concrete action with a confirm
Dark, restrained brand with a single violet or brand-colour glow

look.type_style: geometric sans, medium weight, sentence case, normal tracking, small captions about 3 % of frame height, centred

structure.shot: caption, 5 words, names the core promise; centred on black; thin violet arc rim in the lower left
structure.camera: drift: arc rotates slowly about 4 deg/s, caption fixed
structure.motion: caption present from f0, no entrance; holds 53 fr; cut out (exit not measurable, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: 3D phone with the home screen (balance card, 6 asset tiles, tab bar); spins from front through back and edge into a tilted close-up, then settles frontal
structure.camera: orbit around the phone with push-in about 17 %/s (s 2-3), then pull-out -7.6 %/s (s 3-4), settles frontal at about 0.9 frame height
structure.motion: phone y-rotation about 360 deg over 15 fr (front f53, back f60, edge f68, screen f75) easings.outExpo (±0.25 s); tilted close-up glides 30 fr; settle springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: caption, 4 words, names the fast sign-up; centred on black; arc rim lower left
structure.motion: caption cut in at f143, holds 45 fr, cut out (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: 3D phone in perspective showing the sign-up form (two fields, primary button, three social sign-in rows); camera travels down the screen
structure.camera: dolly: rises from below frame, then travels down the screen, vertical pan up to 465 px/s at 1920 wide (s 7-8), push-in 5-11 %/s
structure.motion: phone enters from lower frame f188 tilted about 20 deg, springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable); travel easings.inOutSine 67 fr

structure.shot: caption, 5 words, introduces the in-app assistant; arc rim now rising on the left edge, faint glow top right
structure.camera: drift: arc rotates and grows toward top right
structure.motion: caption cut in at f255, holds 60 fr, cut out (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: dark chat panel with the assistant name header and a divider; the user's question types inside a violet pill, 6 words
structure.motion: panel appears at f315 (entrance not measurable, ±0.25 s); prompt typed about 12 chars/s, pill grows with the text, springs.ui

structure.shot: same panel; a small searching status line with animated dots on the left
structure.camera: static panel; arc rim enters at top right
structure.motion: status line appears f353, dots cycle; holds 30 fr

structure.shot: assistant answer streams into a grey bubble under a processed-time label, 3 lines, recommends one asset and offers a monthly amount
structure.camera: static panel; arc glow brightens top right
structure.motion: answer streams about 5 words/s for 60 fr, bubble height grows springs.layout; holds 15 fr

structure.shot: one-line flow: amount on the left, arrow with a small label, asset name on the right
structure.motion: amount and asset fade in from blur 8 fr (±0.25 s); label blur-in at f473; arrow draws left to right 30 fr easings.outQuint

structure.shot: thin violet ring with a spinner arc, resolves to a bold violet check
structure.motion: spinner 8 fr, check stroke draws and ring fills in about 8 fr springs.pop (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: caption, 6 words, positions the product as more than an app; blurred violet band growing behind
structure.camera: drift: arc band widens and brightens
structure.motion: caption cut in at f540, holds 60 fr

structure.shot: caption, 7 words, the closing claim, revealed word by word from dim grey to white
structure.camera: drift: violet band sweeps across the upper half
structure.motion: word-by-word, about 3 words per 0.25 s, each word fades grey to white over 8 fr and settles from a slight drop easings.outExpo; full line by f623; holds 22 fr

structure.shot: mark above a wide wordmark, centred, white on black with the violet band
structure.motion: lockup appears f660 (entrance not measurable, ±0.25 s), holds 53 fr
URL resolves from blur in under 8 fr (±0.25 s), holds to the end

params.brand: dark brand.json: accent drives the arc, pill and check; text font for captions
params.content.captions: 5 short captions (4-7 words): promise, sign-up, assistant, positioning, closing claim
params.content.homeScreen: phone home UI: balance, change chip, 6 asset tiles
params.content.signupScreen: sign-up UI: 2 fields, primary button, 3 social rows
params.content.question: user question to the assistant, about 6 words
params.content.answer: assistant answer, 3 lines, ends in an offer of one action
params.content.flow: {amount, label, target} for the confirm line
params.content.url: product URL for the last card

notes: No cuts detected by scdet (near misses 1.60, 4.60, 8.30 s); all row boundaries are state changes read from the 4 fps sheets, ±0.25 s. Captions are small (about 3 % H) and switch on and off without visible entrances. The violet arc is one continuous background across the whole film: thin rim lower left (0-10 s), moves to top right (12 s on), widens into a blurred band and brightens to the end. Phone in rows 2 and 4 is a rendered 3D model (spin, perspective); PhoneFrame with tilt is the 2D fallback. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not used as ids): check-confirm, arrow-flow.
